_comment: Single source of truth for drifting facts (model IDs, prices, defaults). Lints read allowedModelIds. Every entry carries where it came from. asOfGuide: whether it existed when Exam Guide v1.0 (July 2026) was written; 'unknown' means do not build exam items on it; 'likely' means the beta predates the guide, so concept items are fine but not parameter names.
verifiedFrom: Anthropic claude-api reference (model table cached 2026-09-25) and platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.thinking: always on (adaptive); disabled or budget_tokens returns 400

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.thinking: cannot be disabled; effort is the only control

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.thinking: adaptive by default; disabled only at effort high or below

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.thinking: adaptive by default; disabled returns 400, use between_tools

examples.note: Study-site code uses Sonnet 5.5 as the everyday model and Haiku 4.5 for cheap, high-volume calls so examples stay inexpensive to run.

sdkDefaults.retried: 408, 409, 429, 5xx and connection errors, with exponential backoff
sdkDefaults.timeout: 10 minutes (Python seconds, TypeScript milliseconds); TS scales up for large non-streaming max_tokens
sdkDefaults.note: Worst-case wall clock is about timeout x (max_retries + 1). The spend-cap 429 has no retry-after and is not recoverable by retrying.

restrictions.fact: budget_tokens returns 400; use adaptive thinking + effort
Forced tool_choice any/tool returns 400; use auto + strict or structured outputs
Batch results arrive in any order; join on custom_id
MCP connector needs mcp_servers plus an mcp_toolset tool (beta mcp-client-2025-11-20)
inference_geo accepts 'us' or 'global' (default) on 4.6+ models; 400 on Haiku 4.5 and earlier; US-only inference priced at 1.1x; workspaces can restrict allowed geos
Batch API is not ZDR-eligible (results retained 29 days)
Fable 5 family requires 30-day retention; not available under ZDR unless expressly authorized

deprecations.note: retirement not sooner than 2026-10-15; watch for a replacement cheap model

fastMode.what: same model, up to 2.5x output tokens per second (not time to first token), separate rate limit, cache not shared across speeds, not on Batch

tokenizer.note: Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that produces about 30% more tokens for the same text; recount with count_tokens when migrating

caching.examRule: teach 0.1x reads and 1.25x / 2x writes; per-model read overrides are post-guide
caching.invalidation: tool definitions invalidate tools, system and messages; tool_choice and image changes invalidate only messages

features.name: context editing
features.asOfGuideNote: beta header date predates the July 2026 guide; parameter-level detail is still drifting, so items may test the concept but not parameter names

features.name: server-side compaction (threshold)
features.asOfGuideNote: beta header date predates the July 2026 guide; parameter-level detail is still drifting, so items may test the concept but not parameter names

features.name: task budgets
features.asOfGuideNote: beta header predates the guide; unsupported on Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 4.6; teach as low exam weight

mcp.examRevisionNote: initialize handshake (protocolVersion, capabilities, clientInfo) then notifications/initialized; teach as exam material
mcp.postGuideNote: stateless: no initialize or Mcp-Session-Id, server/discover; Roots, Sampling, Logging deprecated
mcp.authorization: OPTIONAL in the spec; HTTP transports SHOULD use the OAuth 2.1-based flow; stdio takes credentials from the environment

sdks.typescript: v2 split packages @modelcontextprotocol/server and /client; v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk maintained on v1.x

skills.apiContainer: code execution tool required; no network, no runtime package install
skills.customSkillScope: workspace-wide on the API; per user on claude.ai; no cross-surface sync
skills.frontmatter: name (<=64, lowercase/digits/hyphens) and description (<=1024, what + when)
